note: Knox County NE publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (raster image, no queryable service). The county GIS viewer knox.gworks.com exposes parcel data with no zoning REST service found (/arcgis/rest/services returns 404). The KGIS zoning service found is for Knox County, Tennessee, not Nebraska. No Knox County NE city (Bloomfield, Creighton, Crofton, Center, Niobrara, Verdigre) publishes a queryable zoning layer found in search.
